title: Chao1 Richness Estimator — chao1
text: Chao1 estimator : $$S_{Chao1} = S_{obs} + \frac{f_1^2}{2 f_2}$$ \(f_1\) number singletons (species total abundance 1) \(f_2\) number doubletons (abundance 2). \(f_2 = 0\), bias-corrected form used: $$S_{Chao1} = S_{obs} + \frac{f_1 (f_1 - 1)}{2}$$

title: Sample Completeness Profile — completenessProfile
text: Sample completeness order q : $$C_q = \frac{D_q^{obs}}{D_q^{est}}$$ \(D_q^{obs}\) observed Hill number \(D_q^{est}\) estimated asymptotic Hill number. Completeness near 1 means sample captures true diversity order. Completeness typically increases q dominant species detected early. Asymptotic estimators used: q = 0: Chao1 estimator q = 1: Chao & Jost (2015) entropy estimator q = 2: Inverse Simpson estimator bias correction q: Interpolated adjacent integer estimates coords provided, per-site completeness computed treating site's abundance vector independent sample.

title: Sample Completeness Profile — completenessProfile
